report.summary: At 03:11:38 a restart shrank the DB pool to 2 connections with a 250 ms timeout. An idle-in-transaction session then held a lock, exhausting the pool and causing 500/503 errors and slow transfers.

findings.claim: A restart at 03:11:38 cut poolMaximumSize from 10 to 2 and connection timeout from 30000 ms to 250 ms.
findings.reason: Runtime config shows the changed pool settings starting at the in-window restart.

findings.claim: An 'idle in transaction' session (25306) blocked two ledger_app sessions for up to ~2 s between 03:11:39 and 03:12:43.
findings.reason: Blocker samples show sessions 25304 and 25305 waiting on 25306 across 26-29 samples.

findings.claim: The tiny pool and lock waits exhausted the pool: 163 acquisition timeouts, matching 55 HTTP 500s and 106 HTTP 503s (25.6% server errors) and a p95 of 1.7 s. Outbox throughput also dropped to under 10 per 10 s.
findings.reason: Pool saturation (03:11:40-03:12:40) coincides with the error spike and outbox dip. Blocked sessions hold the 2 connections, so waiters hit the 250 ms timeout.

limitations: A 10 s scrape gap at 03:11:30-03:11:40 and 2 counter restarts limit exact counts; NaN gauges were treated as missing.
The origin of idle-in-transaction session 25306 and the reason for the config change are not shown.
